# Promo & Grow — Master Source Pack (for NotebookLM)
### Clean, corrected source of truth. Feed this into NotebookLM to generate accurate podcasts, video explainers, and infographics.

---

## 1. Who we are
Promo & Grow is a 20-plus-year, family-built, Lynwood–Los Angeles custom event-branding company. It is the evolution of **PrintCo Direct Inc.**, carrying forward the founding promise: *Promote & Grow.* We make brands look unforgettable at their moment — custom tents, table covers, flags, trade-show/SEG fabric displays, wall art, banners, and full print collateral. Everything is made to order and **delivered in 5 business days.** Owner: Carlos A. Diaz Jr. Sister company: Proágo Branding (agency-level work).

## 2. Positioning (the one-line truth)
**Promo & Grow equips the entrepreneur operating on *ganas* to show up like a pro — fast.** *Ganas* is the hunger and drive of the self-made. We sell the moment a scrappy hustle starts looking like a legitimate, market-leading operation. Signature line: ***"Tu evento, tu marca, hecho bien."***

## 3. The moat (why we win)
We're the only player combining **agency-level craft + local-shop relationship and bilingual warmth + national-level 5-day speed — at an accessible price.** National online printers (Vistaprint, 4over-fed sites) are faceless and templated; local sign shops are slow and dated; branding agencies are expensive and intimidating. We sit in the gap.

## 4. Voice
A bilingual growth partner — warm, confident, encouraging, real. We talk *with* customers like a neighbor who happens to be a pro, never *at* them like a vendor. Natural Spanish/English code-switching, used with taste. **Anti-brand (never):** salesy/pushy, cold/corporate, condescending, cheap-looking, generic, overpromising. Confidence comes from delivering, not bragging.

## 5. The two proof pillars (say these everywhere)
- **5-day delivery, guaranteed.** Competitors quote 7–14 days; we produce in-house and deliver in five business days (four on print). This is the hero stat.
- **Free proof.** Every order includes a free digital artwork proof. Nothing prints without the customer's approval — it removes the risk.

## 6. What we sell (core offerings)
- **Event tents / canopies:** 10x10, 10x15, 10x20 — Tent Only through Complete Set (tent + walls + bag).
- **Table covers & throws:** runner + throw, draped, stretch/fitted, round.
- **Flags:** feather (angled/convex), teardrop, rectangle, econo 16ft.
- **Trade-show displays:** SEG tension-fabric backdrops (3ft–20ft), backlit popups, curved/straight, velcro popups, pillowcase backdrops.
- **Wall art:** stretch canvas, fabric SEG frames, standoff acrylic.
- **Tent accessories:** back walls, half walls, tent banners, printed podium/hard case.
- **Print collateral:** business cards, postcards, flyers/brochures, NCR forms and form pads, 13oz banners, vehicle magnets. (All loaded in Shopify as quoting products.)

## 7. Pricing model (internal logic — do not put exact markups in customer-facing media)
Catalog items sell at set prices. Custom print is marked up from vendor cost; large-format/displays carry a smaller multiplier. There is always a floor: a **$100 minimum order** and a minimum margin. **Reps quote from the set price sheet, never from raw cost.** (Exact markup multipliers are confidential and live only in the internal pricing engine.)

## 8. How we sell — the concierge close
Most revenue comes through a human "concierge close," not the website cart: a customer calls, texts, emails, or submits a quote → we build a Shopify draft order → send an invoice with a warm note → they pay via a quick Shop Pay checkout → production starts on proof approval. Speed-to-lead (responding within minutes) is the single biggest close factor.

## 9. Objection handling
Backbone is **LAER: Listen, Acknowledge, Explore, Respond.** For price, layer **Feel-Felt-Found.** Always fall back to the free proof. Persistence matters: most sales need multiple "no"s before a "yes."

## 10. Reactivation (the current growth play)
PrintCo Direct served hundreds of businesses over six years (peak ~817 orders in 2021, down to ~206 in 2025). Those proven past buyers are the warmest outreach there is. The sales rep reconnects — *"PrintCo Direct is now Promo & Grow"* — and offers a reorder or the new event-display line. Call first.

## 11. Guardrails (important for accuracy in any generated media)
- **Institutional accounts are handled by Carlos, not reps:** City of South Gate, City of Lynwood, Lynwood Unified School District, Nova Storage. *(Kaiser Permanente and Lynwood Unified appear in our heritage as credibility/trust references — they are not rep outreach targets.)*
- **Bigger branding** — vehicle wraps, channel letters/signage fabrication, brand guides/systems — escalates to Carlos / Proágo. Design is **not** included in standard orders; we proof and print (and provide free Canva templates), we are not a full design agency.

## 12. Personas (who we serve)
- **"La Emprendedora"** — local Spanish-speaking small-business owner (taquería, quinceañera vendor, panadería, food truck) with a moment coming up; lives on her phone; trusts people over platforms. The heart of the brand.
- **"The Brand Manager"** — marketing manager at a growing company with a trade show and a deadline; wants a partner who just delivers.
- **"The Agency / Event Pro"** — runs activations; needs a dependable production partner and easy reorders.
